name: Stagwolf
description: A massive wolf-like predator crowned with broad elk antlers, hunting through coordinated charges and brutal pack attacks.

abilities.name: Pack Tactics
abilities.description: When the Stagwolf succeeds on a standard attack against a target with another Stagwolf within Melee range, deal 1d6+5 physical damage instead and gain a Fear.

abilities.name: Antler Rush
abilities.description: Move into Melee range of a target within Close range and make an attack. On a success, deal 1d8+4 physical damage and knock the target back to Very Close range. If they collide with a solid object or another creature, they mark a Stress.
